build_PerfStats: build PerfStats to estimate flops, read bytes, and write bytes per GPU for transformer inference
create_ExecutionContext: create ExecutionContext to aggregate prefill and decode request statistics across a batch
test_ComponentMetrics: test ComponentMetrics subclasses to derive per-component flops and memory breakdowns for attention, FFN, and unembedding layers
review_ModelMetrics: review ModelMetrics to compute total flops and memory traffic by aggregating all registered ComponentMetrics
run_PerfMetricsLogging: run PerfMetricsLogging to log MFU in TF/s/GPU and GB/s/GPU with optional debug breakdowns
